attributedDescription.content:
The Royal Enfield Classic 650 has been Janak’s long termer for almost six months, and he has been using it for daily commutes, leisure rides, highway runs and day-long trips. And while it's certainly a motorcycle that turns heads, living with it over an extended period has revealed a few things that you should know before buying one.
